pageSubtitle: Printable parts that work with Attraccess. Everything is generated in your browser.
cardDescription: A 60 x 40 x 2 mm tag with a keyring hole and a pocket for a 25 mm NFC sticker.
labelDescription: Shown large in the middle of the card. Shrinks automatically to fit.
previewAriaLabel: 3D preview of the keychain card. Drag to rotate.
printTip: Two colours: import both parts together. Pause at Z = 1.125 mm to drop in the NFC sticker, then resume.
errorNoOutput: Some characters in this label can't be engraved. Try letters, numbers and basic punctuation.
plugDescription: A two-part tamper-evident cover with two 3 x 5 mm security-seal passages.
plugDeviceDescription: Nous is STEP-derived. Shelly presets use published nominal envelopes; increase clearance after a fit test.
plugShellyPlusGen3: Shelly Plus Plug S / Plug S Gen3
plugDeviceClearanceDescription: Additional diametral space beyond the nominal 0.5 mm fit allowance.
plugCableDescription: Straight cords keep the body closed. Angled cords use the original 30.9 mm cover slot and 34.2 mm body mouth.
cordOpeningDiameterDescription: Sizes the central hole and matching cover slot for a straight cable. Defaults: Schuko 12 mm, Euro 9 mm.
heightAbovePlugDescription: Original profile: 17.8 mm. Increase this for a taller angled connector.
cableCutoutHeightDescription: Vertical height of the existing U-shaped body cutout. Original profile: 24.2 mm.
plugPrintTip: Print body and cover separately. Close them around the plug, then secure both 3 x 5 mm passages with disposable security seals.
plugPreviewAriaLabel: 3D preview of the smart plug security cover. Drag to rotate.
